name: Cistern Tally
description: Tally the force in the cistern against what a hostile source can still give.

name: Open Spigot
description: Open a spigot of soul force on a hostile source and let the cistern fill.

name: Thickened Plate
description: Thicken the wall of the cistern so a hard mental blow cannot crack it.

name: Trickle Lance
description: Let a trickle of stored force run out as a thin lance into a soul.

name: Rising Level
description: Let the cistern rise level by level as a long fight feeds it and raise the strength of each technique.

name: Cistern Rebound
description: Let a hostile blow strike the full cistern and rebound with some of its weight added.

name: Drained Curse
description: Drain a curse from an ally into the cistern and break it down into plain soul force.

name: Vast Intake
description: Open the cistern to a flood of hostile force and take in far more than a single soul could hold.

name: Cascading Siphon
description: Siphon from many foes in turn so each feels its force fall away one after another.

name: Great Cistern
description: Open a great cistern before the self that absorbs the whole force of an incoming soul attack and stores it.

name: Paired Weighing
description: Read two hostile forces at once and tell which of them gives more.

name: Paired Siphon
description: Draw from two hostile sources together and merge their force in the user's reserve.

name: Matched Cover
description: Hold two matched covers of soul force so a blow to one is caught by the other.

name: Double Tithe
description: Take a tithe from both the strike and the striker in a single motion.

name: Balanced Return
description: Return exactly the force drawn and no more against the soul that struck.

name: Twin Cleansing
description: Draw a curse from an ally in one stream while pouring clean force back in the other.

name: Twofold Levy
description: Levy a tithe from every foe within reach and from every blow that lands among them.

name: Matched Rebound
description: Rebound a hostile technique with the exact force it carried and the force drawn from the striker.

name: Paired Absorption
description: Absorb a hostile soul attack with two matched draws so none of its force escapes the user.

name: Far Gleaning
description: Mark from afar the richest stretch of hostile force in a fight.

name: Plunge Draw
description: Plunge on a hostile technique at its richest moment and seize its force.

name: Hooded Cover
description: Hood the soul in a cover of soul force that soaks the first weight of a mental blow.

name: Talon Pluck
description: Pluck the heart out of a target's gathering technique with a talon of soul force.

name: Dropping Away
description: Drop away from a strike while its force is lifted into the user.

name: Wide Reaping
description: Reap hostile force over a wide span and carry the whole harvest back to the reserve.

name: Hawk Rebound
description: Catch a soul strike on spread pinions and fling it back with a share of its own force.

name: Hawk-Eyed Purge
description: Spot the hidden taint in an ally's soul and pluck it out with a talon of soul force.

name: Reaping Dive
description: Dive with drawn force through a soul's guard in a single falling line.

name: Boundless Reaping
description: Reap force from every blow struck in the fight and keep reaping without strain.

name: Hawk's Tithe
description: Seize an incoming soul attack in mid-flight and absorb its whole force into the reserve.

name: Flow Weighing
description: Weigh the flow of hostile force to learn how much of it the soul can drink.

name: Channel Draw
description: Cut a channel from a hostile source into the reserve and let the force run in.

name: Packed Silt
description: Raise a wall of packed soul force that slows a flood of hostile intent to a trickle.

name: Swelling Intake
description: Let the intake swell with every new stream of hostile force added to the flow.

name: Reversed Flood
description: Turn a flood of hostile force back along its own bed to strike its source.

name: Clarifying Run
description: Run an ally's clouded soul through the flow until curse and taint settle out.

name: Confluence Draw
description: Join many separate streams of hostile force into one and draw them all at once.

name: Deluge Return
description: Pour the drawn flow back as a deluge over every soul that fed it.

name: Engulfing Flood
description: Meet an incoming soul attack with a flood that engulfs it and absorbs all it carries.

name: Breath Taste
description: Read in the breath of the wind which technique nearby has force to spare.

name: Windward Intake
description: Face into the wind of battle and take in the force it carries to the user.

name: Turning Gust
description: Raise a gust of soul force round the self that carries a mental push past.

name: Backdraft Strike
description: Pull a hostile blow into a backdraft and let it strike the soul that threw it.

name: Cyclone Draw
description: Spin a cyclone of soul force that gathers the spill of every nearby technique.

name: Rebounding Gust
description: Meet a soul strike with a gust that spins it round and sends it back.

name: Windswept Purge
description: Blow a curse from an ally's soul on a clean stream of drawn force.

name: Gale-Fed Reserve
description: Keep the reserve fed from a steady gale of drawn force through a whole fight.

name: Storm Repayment
description: Repay a storm of blows with a storm of stored force over every soul that struck.

name: Hurricane Intake
description: Spin a hurricane of soul force that absorbs every hostile force entering it.

name: Well Depth
description: Sound the depth of the well to learn how much more force it will hold.

name: Rainfall Intake
description: Let the well catch the falling spill of techniques like rain and keep it.

name: Wellhead Cover
description: Set a cover of soul force over the wellhead so a mental blow cannot foul the well.

name: Rising Water
description: Let the water in the well rise with each blow absorbed and lift the user's techniques.

name: Lifted Pail
description: Lift a full pail of stored force from the well and fling it at a soul.

name: Reclaiming Rain
description: Pour clean well force over an ally like rain and wash the taint from the soul.

name: Endless Well
description: Draw from the well as if it had no bottom through a whole long fight.

name: Overflowing Well
description: Let the full well overflow in a wave that strikes every soul near the user.

name: Drinking Sky
description: Open the well to the sky and absorb every hostile force that falls toward the user.

name: Draw Held
description: Hold a draw open and feel the pull of hostile force against it stay level.

name: Unbroken Intake
description: Take in hostile force without a break so the draw never loses its hold.

name: Firm Cover
description: Keep a firm cover of soul force over the self through repeated mental blows.

name: Fastened Hold
description: Fix a hold on a target's force that does not loosen as the target strains.

name: Steady Return
description: Send back a steady share of the drawn force into the soul that provided it.

name: Lasting Siphon
description: Hold a siphon on a hostile source through a whole long exchange and lose none of its yield.

name: Resolute Rebound
description: Rebound each soul strike with the force just drawn from the one before it.

name: Unwavering Purge
description: Hold a steady draw on a curse in an ally until it has left the soul entire.

name: Draining Bind
description: Bind a target in a draw that feeds the user a little more with each of its struggles.

name: Continuous Intake
description: Keep the reserve filling from every hostile source in reach with no gap between draws.

name: Unbroken Return
description: Return a long exchange's drawn force through a soul's guard in one unbroken line.

name: Unflagging Maw
description: Hold open a maw of soul force that absorbs all hostile force offered to it without tiring.

name: Remote Tally
description: Gauge from far off how much force a hostile source still has to give.

name: Extended Draw
description: Cast a long draw across open space and pull hostile force into the user.

name: Long Cover
description: Throw a cover of soul force ahead of the self that soaks a mental blow before it arrives.

name: Reaching Drain
description: Pull at a far target's force from across open space and thin it.

name: Trailing Siphon
description: Leave a siphon trailing behind a retreating foe and keep drawing as it flees.

name: Remote Rebound
description: Rebound a strike at a distance with a draw laid ahead of the user.

name: Remote Purge
description: Reach across a span to draw taint from an ally's soul without a touch.

name: Wide Reclamation
description: Reclaim spent force over a great span and bring it back to the reserve.

name: Long Return
description: Send stored force the whole length of a laid draw into a distant soul.

name: Reach Absorption
description: Absorb a hostile soul attack at a great distance before it can come near the user.
